label: Dramatic Light
description: High-contrast, moody, stylized light — the theatrical end of the spectrum.

items.name: chiaroscuro
items.text: chiaroscuro lighting, a single hard source carving the subject out of deep darkness

items.name: neon-rim
items.text: electric neon rim light in magenta and cyan outlining the subject against darkness

items.name: single-practical
items.text: one bare practical bulb overhead, harsh pool of light, hard-edged noir shadows

items.name: volumetric-shafts
items.text: volumetric light shafts cutting through haze, crisp god-ray beams and glowing dust

items.name: silhouette-backlight
items.text: powerful backlight reducing the subject to a rim-lit silhouette with a burning edge

items.name: police-strobe
items.text: alternating red and blue emergency strobes sweeping the scene, hard color contrast

items.name: lightning-flash
items.text: a frozen lightning flash, stark white illumination against a storm-dark scene

items.name: underlight
items.text: eerie light from below, inverted shadows giving an unsettling theatrical look

items.name: stage-spot
items.text: a tight theatrical spotlight in haze, everything outside its cone falling to black

items.name: split-lighting
items.text: hard split lighting, one half of the subject lit, the other in full shadow
